svg.title: The ten benchmark questions
svg.desc: A typographic index of the ten queries run against the BTS flights dataset, each with its query type.

g.text: Average departure and arrival delay by carrier,
by month, over the full date range
On-time percentage by airport, by year
All flights for one tail number on one date
Distribution of departure delay by day of week
min, max, avg, p50, p90, p99
Total flights and average delay by airport and carrier,
joined with airport metadata (state, city, name)
Rolling 7-day average delay per major airport
Count of flights per day across the full history
Carriers ranked by on-time performance for a given
